# Contributing to Clip Squeezer

Contributions are welcome through GitHub pull requests.

## Before contributing

- Search existing issues and pull requests before starting substantial work.
- For significant changes, open an issue first so the approach can be discussed.
- Keep changes focused, include tests where appropriate, follow the existing code style, and update documentation when behaviour changes.

## Pull requests

Pull requests should explain the problem they solve, avoid unrelated refactoring, pass existing automated tests and checks, and not introduce unnecessary dependencies. Please disclose any generated or copied code whose licensing may need review.

## Licensing of contributions
